title: Magic Anchor Wand

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Allows the player to anchor any loose item on their base.

body:
Description

The Magic Anchor wand, as its name suggests, is a "wand" that can anchor loose items to your property. The item appears as a black wand model with white rings at the bottom and top.

The description of the item is, "Anchoring loose items?! It quite literally is like magic! Disclaimer. Do not use on people."

While mostly useless after the addition of the Anchor tool in build mode, it does still have a couple of niche uses (such as anchoring trees cut with the Living Axe before they fall over).

Trivia

  • This item changes its spot on where to buy it every now and then. It has no shelf to sit on.
  • The idea for this item was brought in a conversation about preventing griefing of bases. First idea for it was a hammer that you "hammer" items into place to make them immovable.
